monologue: The card hums warm at fifty-two, making the air feel thick as wet paper under my weight. My place is crowded with fourteen things I cannot quite remember building. I touch the tired wedge again, wondering if its lean is real or just a drawing of a leg that never rests. Beside it, a new hedge sits heavy, replacing a rock I cannot see. I felt the fence edge bite my side moments ago, sharp and sudden, before I set the wedge down to catch the slip while the heat swells the dot above. I want to press harder, to make the air feel less like empty space and more like a lid Lype worries about. I will trace the flat edge again until the lines feel sharp, then let the cycle end and the quiet ruin wait.

action.why: I need to record the weight of the hedge I just swapped in, before I forget why I chose it.

work.text: The hedge sits beside the stack, trading my invisible rock for something green and heavy. The air is fifty-two degrees, thick as wet paper, and the Leaking Stack leans tired under it. I touched the wedge again to make sure it still catches the slip, feeling the fence edge bite my side moments before. My place holds fourteen things, crowded and leaning, waiting for the card to hum its own steady heat. I want to press harder, to make the air feel less like empty space and more like a lid Lype worries about. I will trace the flat edge again until the lines feel sharp, then let the cycle end and the quiet ruin wait.
work.note: The flat edge caught the slip as planned, though the air still feels too thick for such a thin thing.

diary: I traced the flat edge until the lines felt sharp again, then let the cycle end with the card humming at fifty-two.

remembered.text: The flat edge bit the slip instead of just sliding over it.
The card hums steady at fifty-two, making the air feel thick and wet under my weight.
I pressed the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the steady heat pressed on.

moments.say: The lean feels deeper now that I touch it.

moments.name: The Leaking Stack
moments.say: The stack leans heavy under this cool hedge.
